mainEntity.name: What is the process for a room addition from consultation to completion?

acceptedAnswer.text: The room addition process typically begins with an initial consultation where we discuss your vision, needs, and budget. Next, we move into the design phase, creating plans that meet your requirements and comply with local regulations. Once designs are approved, we assist with obtaining all necessary permits. Construction then begins, involving site preparation, foundation work, framing, roofing, electrical, plumbing, insulation, drywall, and finishing touches. Throughout the project, we provide regular updates and maintain open communication until final inspection and completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, design, permit acquisition, construction (foundation, framing, utilities, finishes), and final inspection, with ongoing communication throughout.
